Canonical 2026-09-01 UZ App Store public search for the non-branded query weather records >192; the August 28 baseline was #81. A bounded absence is not converted into a synthetic rank.

Current App Store Connect reported conversion is 4.86% on 300 reported impressions. The supplied counts do not reproduce the metric, and the 15% target is evaluated only after at least 500 eligible impressions.
Play listing conversion remains the reported 2026-08-28 value. Its source numerator and denominator were not shown in the August 31 global dashboard recheck, so it is not a reconciled KPI.
Directional global last-28-days calculation: 18 device first launches divided by 25 installs = 72.00%. The UI does not prove identical populations.

blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The canonical 2026-09-01 capture at 2026-09-01T01:02:39+05:00 fails every required category surface, so the verified streak remains 0/7: Apple weather search is >192, the official Apple Weather chart is #66, all three fixed logged-out Google category profiles are outside the first 30, and 0/5 generic Google queries meet the diagnostic benchmark. The auxiliary Apple Toshkent ob-havo search returned only one unique result and remains a non-goal diagnostic error; required goal evidence is complete. The current App Store Connect overview reports 300 impressions, 23 product-page views, 8 first downloads, 1 redownload, 3 updates, and 4.86% conversion; retention is insufficient. The conversion is preserved as reported because the supplied counts and report window do not reproduce it. A separate public Apple UZ lookup reports 1 rating at 5.0 while public version 1.0.1 remains live. Public iOS 1.0.1 (4) has three consented crashes in the current 30-day and 90-day App Store Connect Analytics windows. The seven-day August 26 through September 1 window contains two, on August 29 and August 30. No diagnostic, stack, incident/signature ID, crashed-process identity, binary UUID, or source-defined crash-free-session percentage is exposed. The crash gate therefore remains blocked. Google Play's global last-28-days dashboard counts were revalidated on August 31 at 25 installs, 18 device first launches, and 13 monthly active devices; listing impressions, conversion, and ratings remain carried forward where marked.

Current product/build-input commit fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e is governed by the canonical fail-closed release registry. Product/build-input authority fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e contains the actor-isolation correction and Apple 1.1.0 (10), while Android source identities remain phone 1.1.0 (11) and Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000011). Protected run 33852229166 signed and candidate-byte-verified the exact set, including Apple IPA SHA-256 20e8e4ac61c55d856aedcdf88a27a2f11ac4cb036aa2dfa002e729ace1986061, but it is still transient and not independently trusted. The manifest remains atomically fail-closed: all three current entries have no SHA-256, signing evidence, or runtime evidence, and the previously verified prior-source vc11, vc1000011, and build-9 bytes are retained only as historical-superseded provenance. Build 9 is additionally invalidated by exact TestFlight background-refresh crashes and, although approved in Pending Developer Release, must not be released. The gate remains blocked until run 33852229166 artifact 9929313750 is durably materialized and independently byte-verified; Apple build 10 must then pass the corrected TestFlight background/widget path. Existing Play Internal state was not changed. All predecessor artifacts and observations are historical and non-transferable. OpenMeteo GmbH confirmed non-commercial API entitlement in ticket 234272 for the exact free, non-monetized, unpaid-organic-promotion scope. Predecessor phone and Wear AABs embed 9c2dce4, pass Bundletool and ZIP integrity, and have zero signature entries. Their SHA-256 values are b7c7acb6e90189e8d73e5b8a5f780bf1d3ab36f43edaf3d5076a1dba4e22d4e5 and 2d73fdf1e4fd661a96a699a9fd2ef7b2e989b0f4ab019692ce7c97465673d3fa. Predecessor Apple app, widget, and watch Release simulator hashes are b7c3ba937658007b07ee9ad8e85ddc892e90f423e7839e0dc112a1070ea04849, 7191acd40334d4d9fec6062bc5023450fefbb55006fbd92f57109f41eb27a7ff, and c310c785750ffa779e5dfdc30384088fca889deddb11417f2b4e8e0e30109728; UUID-matched dSYMs verify, but all are ad-hoc simulator products. The full Gradle release gate, shared iOS simulator suite, 18 Apple surface tests, and localization parity pass. A clean predecessor physical General Mobile API 25 run passed Tashkent without location permission, live forecast, truthful late-day Best Time, durable-tip persistence, offline cache, recovery, process health, and cleanup; built and installed APK bytes matched at 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 and the product-scoped fatal/ANR/SSL/CertPath/trust-anchor filter had zero matches. The exact-source API 24 emulator APK 168bb6acdb95453a8dfd141947edbcb9292b756fd3429fffa56fc4baf125dbec retains its live/cache/recovery pass. The byte-identical predecessor debug APK and API 36 installed bytes 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 also passed a fresh no-snapshot Pixel Tablet emulator smoke in Uzbek: landscape onboarding, live forecast, Best Time, durable-tip persistence, home-screen widget render/tap, large text, rotation, process health, and cleanup passed. This is emulator debug evidence, not physical-tablet or upload-signed release proof. Twelve EN/RU/UZ iPhone phone sources now come from the source-bound predecessor 9c2dce4 build-6 simulator app and cover overview, recent comparison, selected timeline, and 10-day/AQI details in each locale. The attempted Apple offline transition was not captured and no Apple offline-state source is claimed. This proves localized phone screenshot provenance only, not signing, physical-device, TestFlight, or store state. Apple Watch sources remain historical build-5 simulator evidence, and prior API 37 round-Wear evidence remains historical. Canonical release authority remains fail-closed. Product/build-input authority fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e contains the actor-isolation correction and Apple 1.1.0 (10), while Android source identities remain phone 1.1.0 (11) and Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000011). Protected run 33852229166 signed and candidate-byte-verified the exact set, including Apple IPA SHA-256 20e8e4ac61c55d856aedcdf88a27a2f11ac4cb036aa2dfa002e729ace1986061, but it is still transient and not independently trusted. Build 9 is additionally invalidated by exact TestFlight background-refresh crashes and, although approved in Pending Developer Release, must not be released. The gate remains blocked until run 33852229166 artifact 9929313750 is durably materialized and independently byte-verified; Apple build 10 must then pass the corrected TestFlight background/widget path. Existing Play Internal state was not changed. Legacy gate ID retained for compatibility; it now represents required Android runtime QA under the product owner's 2026-09-03 emulator-sufficient policy. Protected run 33616952267 signed and candidate-byte-verified phone vc11 and Wear vc1000011 from authority 052d12c7dfa6411428d85205d9568462d20ff87d, run 33626711140 durably materialized their exact bytes, and trusted verification rechecked them. Exact-AAB-derived upload-key-signed vc11 passed clean General Mobile API-25 launch, live provider, Share, refresh, widget render/open, cleanup, and crash/ANR filters. Current-source hosted run 33653344467 passed API 24 phone, API 36 phone, and API 36 tablet Compose UI jobs. A clean Wear OS API 37 emulator install rendered English, Russian, and Uzbek forecast/AQI surfaces and passed 10/10 cold launches with zero matching fatal/ANR records. The dedicated General Mobile is disposable for QA; the Samsung device was not modified. On 2026-09-03 Google Play made exact phone vc11 and Wear vc1000011 available to their Internal testers on tracks 4700083514281298386 and 4699242452771231163. This runtime pass and Internal delivery do not establish post-delivery Vitals, production rollout, or public availability; those remain separately fail-closed. Legacy gate ID retained for compatibility. The owner-approved simulator policy does not override a deterministic crash from the exact distribution candidate: two recovered device reports prove TestFlight 1.1.0 (9) crashed in the main Nimbo process during the Kotlin-to-Swift background-refresh completion on a real iPad running iPadOS 26.6.1. Prior source-bound Share, widget, watch, and simulator coverage remains valid for those exercised paths but did not execute this OS-scheduled completion boundary. Source authority fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e contains the Swift 6 actor-isolation correction, and protected run 33852229166 signed and candidate-byte-verified Apple build 10; it is not yet durably materialized, independently trusted, uploaded, or installed. The gate is blocked until exact build 10 passes source-bound Release validation and background/widget exercise on TestFlight iPhone and iPad without a matching crash. No production submission or release followed. Apple subtitles and creatives remain repository-prepared payloads, not an App Store Connect draft or public store state. The same authenticated preflight found zero existing analytics report requests. Exactly one bounded ONGOING analytics-report-request POST for app 6799886897 returned security 403 without a resource ID; it was not retried, and no duplicate, report instance, segment, user-level data, or PII was created or downloaded. Automated weekly Apple analytics remains permission-blocked for the current key. The domain and point-in-time store-policy gates remain pass, every critical console guardrail remains unknown, and the latest validated weekly Play slice has zero UZ visitors, so UZ conversion remains unknown; its 42.31% all-country rate is diagnostic only. Scale status remains hold; public outreach and acquisition scaling remain gated on every blocking canonical quality gate and critical console guardrail.

## Authenticated Play context

At 23:17–23:23 +05:00 on August 31, the global last-28-days dashboard reported 25 installs, 18 device first launches, and 13 monthly active devices. The directional first-launch ratio is 72.00%; it is not promoted to a decision-eligible cohort rate because the UI does not prove identical populations. Play impressions, listing conversion, ratings, and production details remain carried forward where explicitly marked. The separate August 18–24 Store Listings import remains authoritative for its own window: 26 all-country visitors and 11 unique install clicks, while UZ had zero visitors and zero clicks.

A 05:05 +05:00 recheck confirms review request 14 still contains only the Uzbekistan Custom Store Listing's en-US and ru-RU store data and is under review. Managed publishing is off; approval, publication, and rank impact are not verified. A fixed logged-out gl=UZ recheck at the same checkpoint still exposed the pre-review public title Nimbo in both Uzbek and Russian product pages, so propagation is explicitly not verified. Phone Internal track 4700083514281298386 is active with the selected four-account License testers group. On September 1 the General Mobile opt-in was accepted and Google Play delivered version 1.1.0 (8) for bounded API 25 cold/live/share, offline/cache/recovery, large-text, and active system-TalkBack smoke. Wear Internal track 4699242452771231163 now has the same tester list and reports Active, but no physical Wear install exists. Evidence: growth/quality/google-play-console-2026-08-31.md and growth/quality/play-delivered-android-smoke-2026-09-01.md, with public response hashes in growth/quality/google-play-public-propagation-2026-09-01.md and the current cross-store state in growth/quality/store-release-recheck-2026-09-01.md.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

gate_snapshot.evidence: Two device system reports recovered read-only on 2026-09-04 prove that exact TestFlight 1.1.0 (9) crashed on the iPad at 2026-09-03 13:45 and 14:49 +05:00. Both reports name the main `Nimbo` process rather than `NimboWidget`, match app/dSYM UUID 86A2A899-D90D-3820-B9FF-E4F35D0C19BF, and show EXC_BREAKPOINT/SIGTRAP on `com.apple.root.default-qos` through `_dispatch_assert_queue_fail` and `_swift_task_checkIsolatedSwift`. Exact-dSYM symbolication resolves the path to the inline completion in `AppDelegate.handleBackgroundRefresh(_:)`, the Swift-to-Kotlin thunk, and `startCancellableBackgroundRefresh` at BackgroundWeatherUpdater.kt:90. Read-only TestFlight build detail separately reports 2 installs, 7 sessions, and 3 crashes for exact build 9; the group aggregate of 22 sessions and 8 crashes spans builds, and only two raw iPad reports were recovered and symbolicated. Build 9 created a MainActor-isolated Swift closure inside `@MainActor AppDelegate`, then Kotlin invoked it from Dispatchers.Default before its inner actor hop could run. Source authority fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e moves the outer completion and expiration callbacks into nonisolated `@Sendable` factories, explicitly hops to MainActor, and advances Apple to build 10. Protected run 33852229166 signed and candidate-byte-verified build 10, but the artifact is not yet durably materialized, independently trusted, uploaded, or exercised through TestFlight. Build 9 is approved in Pending Developer Release under manual release and must remain unreleased. Public 1.0.1 also still lacks a source-defined crash-free-session window. The gate remains blocked.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Keep build 9 unreleased; source-bind a monotonically newer Apple build, exercise its TestFlight background/widget path on iPhone and iPad, then collect post-release crash-free evidence

query.sql:
-- Reproducible bounded store-evidence snapshot based on the 2026-08-31 console
-- reads and the 2026-09-01 public Apple UZ rating/version lookup.
-- Apple overview values and selected Google global last-28-days dashboard
-- values are current read-only observations. Stale listing values are marked.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('App Store', 'Impressions', '300', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('App Store', 'First-time downloads', '8', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('App Store', 'Conversion rate', '4.86%', 'live_console_2026-08-31_reported'),
    ('App Store', 'Ratings', '1', 'public_itunes_lookup_uz_2026-09-01'),
    ('App Store', 'Crashes', '2', 'live_console_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Impressions', '779', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),
    ('Google Play', 'Installations', '25', 'live_global_last_28_days_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'First launches', '18', 'live_global_last_28_days_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Monthly active devices', '13', 'live_global_last_28_days_2026-08-31'),
    ('Google Play', 'Conversion rate', '40.82%', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated'),
    ('Google Play', 'Ratings', '1', 'carried_forward_2026-08-28_not_revalidated')
) AS baseline(platform, metric, value, evidence_class);
query.description: Loads the bounded 2026-08-31 store-console evidence plus the September 1 public Apple UZ rating/version lookup while keeping current global Play dashboard counts distinct from stale listing metrics.
filters: Console snapshot date 2026-08-31; public Apple UZ lookup rechecked 2026-09-01
Apple public UZ rating 5.0 from 1 rating; no review text exposed
Google installs, first launches, and monthly active devices are current global last-28-days counts
Google impressions, listing conversion, and ratings are carried forward from 2026-08-28
No cross-platform or cross-window denominator coercion
metric_definitions: Apple conversion is the App Store Connect reported 4.86% and is not recomputed from supplied counts
Retention is insufficient and remains unknown rather than zero
Play conversion is the 2026-08-28 reported baseline and was not revalidated on 2026-08-31
First launch rate is 18 / 25 = 72.00% and remains directional
Monthly active users is displayed as the Play Console's monthly active devices count

-- Baseline-versus-target percentages used in the growth control room.
-- The Play conversion and launch-rate reads remain directional until their
-- source populations and time windows are reconciled.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('Apple conversion', 'Baseline', 0.0486),
    ('Apple conversion', 'Target', 0.1500),
    ('Play conversion', 'Baseline', 0.4082),
    ('Play conversion', 'Target', 0.3500),
    ('First launch / install', 'Baseline', 0.7200),
    ('First launch / install', 'Target', 0.8000)
) AS drivers(metric, series, rate);
query.description: Builds the reviewed baseline-versus-target driver comparison.
tables_used: inline driver values backed by growth/kpi-framework.json
filters: Only percentage drivers with an observed baseline
metric_definitions: Apple target applies after 500 eligible impressions
Play target applies after 500 store visitors
